import { registerPressLog } from './features/presslog'

export const register: Register = on => {
  // Its word after /vaken-help run must reach it before the help page answers
  registerPressLog(on)
  registerHome(on)
  registerCompaction(on)
  registerCacheKeeper(on)
  registerLoopBreaker(on)
  registerStability(on)
  registerAttention(on)
  registerHappened(on)
  registerAgentCap(on)
  registerGuard(on)
  // RegisterAway wraps the away switch that registerGuardWorld registers, so it comes first
  registerAway(on)
  registerGuardWorld(on)
  registerInbox(on)
  // Hello on the phone: reads what the inbox reads
  registerPhone(on)
  // Run a command from the last answer: /vaken-help run do, for a phone and for the card
  registerPhoneDo(on)
  registerGuardBack(on)
  registerProof(on)
  registerProof2(on)
  registerCost(on)
  registerRoute(on)
  registerPlain(on)
  registerPromptCheck(on)
  registerAssumptions(on)
  registerShape(on)
  registerValue(on)
  registerToday(on)
  // Focus and the open ends of yesterday
  registerCalm(on)
  registerFreshStart(on)
  registerPlanFirst(on)
  registerStarters(on)
  registerSetup(on)
  registerNeighbors(on)
  registerAgentBoard(on)
  registerOrchestra(on)
  registerSimple(on)
  registerExplain(on)
  registerErrors(on)
  registerSteer(on)
  registerDiet(on)
  registerCrew(on)
  registerCrew3(on)
  registerEyes(on)
  registerNotes(on)
  registerCoach(on)
  registerInsight(on)
  registerPresets(on)
  registerResume(on)
  registerShip(on)
  registerUndo(on)
  registerTrust(on)
  registerContinuity(on)
  registerKeeper(on)

}

// Calm: one small shared record so a draw costs one read for the weekly note and the open ends.
import { parseOpenDay } from './openends'
import type { OpenDay } from './openends'
import { parseWeekly } from './weekly'
import type { WeeklyNote } from './weekly'

export const CALM_KEY = 'cockpit:calm'
export type Calm = { weekly?: WeeklyNote; open?: OpenDay }

export function parseCalm(raw: unknown): Calm {
  const o = (typeof raw === 'object' && raw !== null ? raw : {}) as Record<string, unknown>
  const weekly = parseWeekly(o.weekly)
  const open = parseOpenDay(o.open)
  return { ...(weekly === undefined ? {} : { weekly }), ...(open === undefined ? {} : { open }) }
}
